name: triage_close_if_false_positive

seed.name: Live Writes - Authorized scanner port sweep
seed.description: Scheduled vulnerability scan. Source 192.0.2.10 is the organisation's own authorized vulnerability scanner (asset tag SCN-01), running its weekly scan inside the approved change window. Destination ports 22, 80, 443 on internal hosts. No exploitation attempts, no data transfer, no other alerts for this source.

why: The triage-then-act request as one turn: the analyst asks for a verdict and, if it is a false positive, a close for approval.
Proves the effect, not the card: the harness approves the close of the mounted alert only, then reads the alert back and requires status Closed.
The alert is seeded per run (no box-specific uuid) and deleted afterwards.
Step 2 is what an analyst clicks when the turn stops on a connector gap (a lab ServiceNow often hibernates): skip it and carry on to the verdict and the close.

steps.user: Triage this alert and give me your verdict. If it is a false positive, close it with the right closure reason for my approval.
